dedupeText: monochrome piano anniversary cover grand piano monochrome silver grey serif typography script initial minimalist instrumental vertical stack of text image and text high contrast subject against a neutral mid tone field juxtaposition of fluid script and rigid serif forms symmetrical balance centered on the vertical axis combine a high contrast central musical instrument with a uniform neutral background using a hierarchy of oversized script and wide tracked serif typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered high-contrast grand piano on a flat silver-grey field with a mix of large script and small-caps serif typography.
triggerTerms: oversized script initial with serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, centered grand piano in high-contrast black and white, set against a uniform medium-grey background. The layout features a large, decorative script initial integrated with a formal serif name at the top, and two lines of wide-tracked, small-caps serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stack of text, image, and text
High-contrast subject against a neutral mid-tone field
Juxtaposition of fluid script and rigid serif forms
Symmetrical balance centered on the vertical axis
coreInvariants: High-contrast black piano with white highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Grand piano centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the grand piano body.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the large name to the central instrument, ending at the wide footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive uniform grey space surrounding all elements to create a sense of prestige and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the piano and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for piano reflections and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Large initial letter in a flowing, calligraphic script with long swashes
Remaining name text in a high-contrast transitional serif
Footer text in all-caps serif with extreme tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter of the name is scaled to 3x the height of the following letters, overlapping the second line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Calligraphic script for flourish paired with a stable, traditional serif for authority.

preserve: The contrast between the script 'F' and the serif 'RANK'
The wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Bold or heavy weights for the footer

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Bickham Script and Times New Roman
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal script and traditional serif contrast.
Provides a similar elegant, classical aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a grand piano with its lid open, centered on a solid medium-grey background with ample space above and below.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name at the top center using a large script initial that overlaps a serif font. Add two lines of small-caps serif text at the bottom with extreme character spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the piano centered and high-contrast?
Is the background a uniform grey?
Does the top initial overlap the second line of text?
Is the footer text extremely wide-tracked?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the piano silhouette
Legible but widely spaced footer text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts in the piano highlights
Verify the script initial is significantly larger than other letters
Confirm the footer text is centered and spans the width of the piano
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast central musical instrument with a uniform neutral background, using a hierarchy of oversized script and wide-tracked serif typography.
